newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 21.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The UAE boosted spending to its highest level in 1996, encouraged by surging oil prices to increase allocations for subsidies, an official report said.
- Firms engaged in cigarette trade in the UAE have been given a three-month grace period from August 26 to reduce nicotine and tar levels in cigarettes to 0.6 and 10 milligrams respectively.
- The aggregate balance sheet of the UAE's 19 national banks rose to 150.6 billion dirhams in the first quarter of 1997 compared to 145.7 billion in the last quarter of 1996.
- Gold imports to Dubai in the first half of 1997 stood at 307.8 tonnes, up 81.8 percent from the first half of 1996.

- The executive council of Abu Dhabi emirate agreed to grant the necessary permit for the establishment of the Abu Dhabi National Company for Industrial Projects as a joint stock company under establishment with a capital of 51 million dirhams.
